actions.script: import java.time.LocalDate import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit def _today = LocalDate.now() def _flagship = (tenantsList ?: []).findAll { it.organizationPartyId == '100000' }.collect { it.tenantId } as Set cycleSubOptions = [] (activeSubsForCycle ?: []).each { s -> if (_flagship.contains(s.tenantId)) return def dleft = '' if (s.renewalDate != null) { long dl = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(_today, new java.sql.Date(s.renewalDate.getTime()).toLocalDate()) dleft = ' — now ' + dl + 'd left' } cycleSubOptions.add([id: s.subscriptionId, label: (tenantNames[s.tenantId] ?: s.tenantId) + ' — ' + s.planId + '/' + s.billingCycle + dleft + ' [' + s.subscriptionId + ']']) }

label.text: Prepare a subscription for upgrade-proration testing: makes it the tenant's SINGLE Active subscription and mid-cycle (e.g. 15 of 30 days remaining) by moving the start/renewal dates, expiring any other active/trial subs, and syncing the tenant's plan. Nothing is charged here, and the renewal date stays in the future. Then upgrade the tenant's plan to a higher one (Tenants → open the tenant → Change Plan) to generate the prorated invoice. The flagship live tenant is protected.
